title: Wire Fencing Around the Farm for Crop Protection

scheme.name: Wire Fencing Around the Farm for Crop Protection
scheme.summary: The scheme aims to provide financial aid to farmers to install wire fencing, helping prevent damage to crops from wild and stray animals.
eligibility: The applicant must be a landholding farmer or a farmer group
The applicant must have a minimum of 2 hectares (ha) of land in a cluster.
Only one of the holders mentioned in 8-A land records per account is eligible for benefits with the consent of other holders.
A farmer is eligible for assistance for a maximum of one account.
exclusions: Farmers who have already availed benefits under the Solar Fencing Scheme are not eligible for this scheme.
scheme.benefits: Per Running Meter ₹200/- or 50% of the actual expenditure incurred, whichever is less. Available once in a lifetime.
documents: Consent Letter from other land account holders (if applicable).
Van Adhikar Patra or Sanad (for farmers in forest areas).
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online via I-Khedut Portal by visiting https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/
